claims.text:
qd-stepping-stones

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:qd-stepping-stones` → `ai-qd-stepping-stones` → `src/demos/ai/ai-qd-stepping-stones`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/186`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30f.md#12-qd-stepping-stones`. **Packet:** E1. **Level / prerequisites:** stretch; `ai:map-elites`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** map-elites stores cell winners; this proves a specific low-quality parent’s retained lineage is the only supplied route to a high-quality niche.

**Computed primary model:** Finite mutation graphA→C,C→C,B→D,D→D. QualityA5,B1,C6,D10; behaviour binsA/C0,B1,D2. Initial candidatesA/B. Single-best keepsA, discardsB; one mutation round reachesC6 and future rounds remainC. Per-bin archive keepsA0/B1; mutate both incumbents once: C replacesA inbin0, D opensbin2 withquality10. D’s parent was the inferiorB.

**Countercase / boundary:** Coarsen all descriptors to one bin: archive discardsB at initial insertion and can no longer reachD under this mutation graph. A retained low-quality individual need not be useful under a different mutation map. This supplied lineage is a finite stepping-stone example, not a guaranteed QD advantage.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict which parent reachesD; recall keeping a candidate matters only if later variation can use it and descriptor competition does not delete it.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Insert candidates/Mutate incumbents computes archive replacement and parent pointers, compared with single-best; Coarsen bins exposes disappearance of that lineage, retaining originalB→D witness.

**Source obligation:** Declared finite construction and reproduced arithmetic support only this toy. Independently derive every visible claim; acquire an original method body with exact locator before adding generalized performance, history or empirical assertions. Primary MAP-Elites lead: [Mouret–Clune2015](https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.04909), not newly acquired here; no empirical discovery or theoretical guarantee borrowed.
